summary: SiriusPoint Ltd, a Bermuda-domiciled NYSE-listed specialty insurer, furnished a routine Form 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting third-quarter 2026 results and making available its financial supplement and investor slide presentation. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. The earnings release headlined third-quarter 2026 results and an announced loss portfolio transfer (LPT) on remaining run-off reserves, a reinsurance risk-transfer rather than a change-of-control event. Items 2.02, 7.01 and 9.01 are ordinary disclosure; no special-situations angle or risk-arb setup arises.
